args.name: Evidence-based food sample assessment
args.function: Assess an owned unfamiliar food sample using feasible physical tests, reporting only what the tests establish about edibility, toxicity, nutrition, or required preparation, with explicit uncertainty.
args.conditions: I am beside the mature hazelnut plant start-1-nuts. Direct observation established stock and growing conditions, not food safety. Hazelnut nutrition, toxicity, and preparation requirements are unknown to me. Known berries remain available in my inventory.
args.inputs: A real owned food sample if needed; any tools, reagents, prerequisites, and sample quantity must be specified before testing.
args.costs: Method, time, energy, materials, and learning requirements are unknown. Prefer a low-risk reusable method; no eating an unknown sample merely to infer safety.
args.effects: Enable an actual bounded investigation with measured findings and stated limitations. Do not reveal hidden properties without a supporting test or claim that a negative limited test guarantees safety.

response.text: {"queries":[],"result_json":"{\"reviews\":[{\"actor\":\"kai\",\"decision\":\"reuse\",\"ability\":\"probe\",\"reason\":\"The existing probe operation directly supports the requested smallest executable investigation: observing a nearby subject or physically testing a small owned sample, with effects restricted to measured facts. Its observe, press, wet and heat modes cover feasible preliminary physical assessment without implying a comprehensive food-safety assay. The related capability search and exact probe and consult contracts have been reviewed. Reuse probe rather than develop a duplicate assessment interface. Neither the plant's maturity nor these limited tests establishes hazelnut edibility, toxicity, nutrition or required preparation.\",\"specification\":\"Reuse open-baseline:probe:1, handler open.probe, revision foundation-open@1, without changing its contract. Arguments are target (visible reference, maximum 360 characters), mode (observe, press, wet or heat), and intensity (number from 0 to 1). Resolve the actual visible target and validate physical access before action; do not infer or expose concealed resource properties. start-1-nuts is the observed plant, not an owned food sample. Kai currently owns only item-4-kai-35, four berries; do not create a hazelnut sample or consume those berries implicitly. To test hazelnut material, first obtain an actual owned sample through an independently executed applicable acquisition operation. The existing gather operation, base:gather:1 / forest.gather / foundation-forest@1, requires source interaction range, finite accessible stock, one round and 2 energy per unit; its quantity is an integer of at least one. Acquisition must actually transfer source stock into an identified owned stack before probe can consume a sample from it. No acquisition or travel is performed by this review.\\nA probe observation costs one round and 0.2 energy; a physical trial costs one round, 0.5 energy and 0.1 actual material unit. Before a trial, identify the owned input stack and exact available quantity, the selected mode, and every required physical means. Bare-hand observation or pressing is the minimal option where physically applicable. Wetting requires actual accessible liquid and any necessary containment; heating requires an actual usable heat source and safe means of handling. None is supplied by this decision. If the existing handler cannot establish or account for a mode's necessary physical inputs, leave that trial unavailable rather than produce a simulated result; a genuinely missing mechanism belongs in the current-conversation development handoff. Do not invent a reagent, heat supply or diagnostic sensitivity.\\nUse only executable existing modes and report only their directly supported observations: for example, visible condition or an actually observed response to the performed manipulation. Do not promise any particular response. No tasting, feeding another participant, or consuming an unfamiliar sample is part of this operation. A negative limited observation means only that the tested condition was not observed under the recorded method; it is not evidence of general safety. Quantitative nutrition, toxin identity or concentration, and validated preparation requirements remain unknown unless separately supported by an applicable real measurement and its established interpretation. Reading Kai's berry record through consult does not transfer its findings to hazelnuts.\\nEach execution lasts one round, with interruption policy cancel: no resumable partial assay or success on an unfinished trial. Repetition is a new execution with new costs, not free progress. Record completed work, actual costs, input identity and amount, method, intensity, conditions, result and limitations. Deduct material exactly once; record consumed or altered sample as spent material/residue rather than returning it as pristine edible stock. Reusable tools remain real tools and are not duplicated. On cancellation, interruption or actor death, stop the action, preserve only completed observations, charge only actually incurred costs and leave surviving unconsumed material subject to normal inventory rules; do not refund spent energy or consumed material. Any reservation must be released once, without creating stock. No autonomous ongoing investigation, maintenance obligation or continuing benefit is created. Actual heating or other independently existing processes retain their own rules. Development/review waiting advances no world time. Execute these constraints in code rather than by repeated model approval; record reuse of the referenced handlers, not reinvention. Public availability does not grant Kai mastery, resources or permission.\",\"learning\":0,\"experienceReview\":\"Functional findings and experience are separate. This review, the request, reading a contract, registration and learning yield no experience benefit. A completed, personally applicable observation may qualify only if it verifiably adds information, including a genuinely informative failure; repeating an unchanged query or unsupported conclusion does not. Familiar legitimate hands-on practice may sustain modest benefit only through actual participation, not merely invocation. Use only an already implemented bounded experience rule with functional deduplication, an explicit cap, decay and cooldown; if none applies, grant no new pleasure or satisfaction effect in this reuse decision. No food nutrition, health gain or comfort increase is supplied by probing. Physical comfort remains capped at 10, nutrition is not reduced by mood, and protected reward accounts, budgets, goals and permissions are unchanged.\",\"visualReview\":\"Use observable execution events and reusable metadata identifying operation, actual target, mode, intensity, progress/status and recorded outcome. Show inspection or a physical manipulation only when it actually occurs; show wetting or heating only when its physical prerequisites are present and used. Retain sample identity, method and uncertainty with any displayed finding. An interrupted, blocked, failed or inconclusive action must be displayed as such, never with a success indicator or a safe-to-eat badge. Display no toxin, nutrition or preparation annotation unless a supporting measurement actually established it. Presentation alone supplies neither a functional effect nor experience credit.\"}]}"}
